#ifndef ESOEXTPT_h
#define ESOEXTPT_h

/*********************************************************************/
/* Header files                                                      */
/*********************************************************************/
#include <netinet/in.h>

#pragma datamodel(P128)

/********************************************************************/
/* Typedef for exit program input structures                        */
/********************************************************************/

typedef _Packed struct Qso_ACPT0100_Format
{
    int  Local_Bound_Address_Length;  /* Len of local bound address */
    union sockaddr_afinetx
      Local_Bound_Address;            /* Address of listening sock  */
    int  Local_Incoming_Address_Length; /* Length of incoming addr  */
    union sockaddr_afinetx
      Local_Incoming_Address;      /* Address connection came in on */
    int  Remote_Address_Length; /* Length of the remote address     */
    union sockaddr_afinetx
      Remote_Address;           /* Address the connection came from */
} Qso_ACPT0100_Format_t;

typedef _Packed struct Qso_CONN0100_Format
{
    int  Local_Address_Length;  /* Length of the local address      */
    union sockaddr_afinetx
      Local_Address;          /* Address of the socket connecting   */
    int  Destination_Address_Length; /* Length of the dest address  */
    union sockaddr_afinetx
      Destination_Address;    /* Destination Address of the connect */
} Qso_CONN0100_Format_t;

typedef _Packed struct Qso_LSTN0100_Format
{
    int  Backlog;               /* Listen backlog queue size        */
    int  Local_Address_Length;  /* Length of the local address      */
    union sockaddr_afinetx
      Local_Address;            /* Address of the listening socket  */
} Qso_LSTN0100_Format_t;

#pragma datamodel(pop)

#endif
